entries.092004b24d8079a0: This is a single-segment business conducted by a group consisting of the company, 7 subsidiaries, 1 associate and 1 other affiliated company. It proposes, builds and provides operation and maintenance services for various solutions related to information networks. Its head office is located in Shinbashi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, and consolidated employees number 2,040 (as of March 31, 2026). The main consolidated subsidiaries are Tsuzuki Techno Service Co., Ltd. (equipment maintenance and operation services), Tsuzuki Software Co., Ltd. (software development), Tsuzuki Cross Support Co., Ltd. (communication equipment construction and maintenance) and Komu Dezain Co., Ltd. (development and provision of SaaS services and construction and maintenance).
entries.17d015cb4ce9bb3a: A system integrator that provides, as one package, the sale of information and communication equipment, system development and construction, operation and maintenance, and monthly subscription services such as cloud.
entries.1e6db2c76e3b90bf: This is a business model that sells information and communications equipment such as servers, storage and PBX systems. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥43,378 million, with growth centered on server and storage deployment projects for manufacturers and government agencies.
entries.34214e6115cfd814: This business model provides consulting, design, development and construction technologies. Network construction associated with office relocations and system development projects mainly for the service and transportation industries grew, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥17,391 million.
